## Journal

- EN: They do not bite; they sip. Their stylets vanish into the fur, leaving only a pinprick and a thirst.
- EN: Morning fog is their highway. In the thick white air, they read scent trails like roads leading straight to the herds.

## Secrets

- Observe 3 Pellizcador clusters on a Rondo. Unlocks move: 'Scent track' (Poke) and reveals their role in the food web.

## Moments

- During a Rondo migration, a sudden crosswind strips the meadow floor. Thousands of Pellizcadores lift off like black dust, catching the thermal updrafts to ride ahead of the herd, a silent, drifting cloud seeking the next meal.
